cd /workspace/tmp && python3 -c "
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from compiler import participant_distance, _deliver, Router, _candidate_orders, _adjacency, _decompose_trees
m=16
links=[(i,(i+1)%m) for i in range(m)]
parts=[(i,1) for i in range(m)]
caps=[8]*m
n=m
dist=participant_distance(n,links,parts,caps)
names=[p[0] for p in parts]
adj,Cset=_adjacency(n,links,caps,parts)
router=Router(n,links,caps); recipes=[];memo={}
for (v,rv) in parts:
    others=[w for w in names if w!=v]
    ok=None
    for order in _candidate_orders(v,others,dist,adj,Cset):
        if set(order)!=set(others): continue
        saved=list(router.res)
        res=_deliver(router,v,rv,order,names,n,dist,recipes,memo)
        if res is None:
            router.res=saved; continue
        recs=_decompose_trees(v,rv,res[0],parts)
        if recs is None:
            print('origin',v,'DECOMP FAIL'); router.res=saved; continue
        ok=res; break
    if ok is None:
        print('origin',v,'DELIVER FAIL'); break
print('res after', router.res[:6])
"
